description.default: One panel for fund NAV, A-share/US/HK quotes and crypto: intraday and candlestick charts, a cost-basis trading ledger (buy/sell/realized P&L), market sessions, symbol search, portfolio overview and CSV export, plus a personal resource library.
description.zh-CN: 一个面板装下基金、行情与大饼：净值、实时报价、分时与日 K 蜡烛图、按成本价记账的买入/卖出与浮动/已实现盈亏、行内记仓、组合总览与导出 CSV、交易时段状态、名称/拼音搜索，另有可自定义的资源库。数据源为公开接口，仅通过 api.net.fetch 读取。
